notes.title: 0.2.3 - Last Playtest Update
notes.content: [p]Before the changelog: This will be the LAST playtest update. [b]The playtest will close in a week. [/b]If you have any achievements which you still want to get or area you want to explore do it now. It will not be playable afterwards and new players will not be able to sign up. Its closing due to playtesting being largely completed and me focusing on a demo of the game - more info on that will come soon. Also, you still have time to get a super special discord role by filling out the feedback form: [url="https://forms.gle/tQf2ZPjt3pLCrpXUA"]https://forms.gle/tQf2ZPjt3pLCrpXUA[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]( Unrelated to this changelog: The community translation project has started! notes.title: 0.1.8 - Titlecards, Modding & Bugfixes
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Created a [url=https://github.com/Stefaaan06/Steam-Leaderboard-Moderation]tool[/url] to modify or remove leaderboard entries, fixing previously broken entries.
[*] Added title card for Chapter 1.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added cooldown to zoom functionality.
[*] Removed assembly stripping to enable modding support.
[*] Game no longer uses compression; while total size is increased, future patches will require smaller downloads and offer faster loading times.
[*] Tweaked object collision particle effects.
[*] Added fog to "The Megastructure"
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed zooming functionality when the game is paused.
[*] Fixed issue causing paper notes to be viewed at incorrect angles.
[*] Various minor fixes.
[/list]


- Stefaaan !!

notes.title: 0.1.6 - Movement Rework & Polish
notes.content:
Hi hello - its finally time for another Update! Over the past weeks since the public playtest has launched I have gotten tons of feedback but the number 1 gripe everyone had was the [b]Movement[/b]. This Update brings big changes to the Movement as well as new Movement options (Its a WIP so any feedback is appreciated!) 

Also, there is now a feedback form, which if completed grants you a super duper special role in my [url=https://discord.gg/VYUedn5bWE]discord [/url](which you should totally join): [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1GjGAVhnRU62lzI9QOaRSevvMUny1Qc-4NMKlak_7Tsc/edit]FEEDBACK FORM[/url]


[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h3]Major Movement Overhaul:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Less floaty and more responsive controls.
[*] Reduced jump cooldown.
[*] Slightly reduced coyote time.
[*] Added vaulting mechanic.
[*] Lots of other fixes
[*] Crouching is less "slidy"
[*] Starting / Stoping a crouch is not instant anymore
[/list]
[h3]Parkour Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked parkour sections in both ventilation areas.
[*] Partially redesigned parkour in "Containers?".
[/list]
[h3]New Secrets:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new hidden secrets to discover.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crouching and uncrouching now have smooth animations.
[/list]
[h3]Command Line Update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked backend command system for easier future updates.
[*] Every command now includes a manual (man) page.
[*] New command for rebinding keys.
[/list]

[h1]Changes & Polish[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved camera shake effects.
[*] Improved audio mixing.
[*] Changed some Music location
[*] Upgraded fall indicator UI for clarity.
[*] Changed object collision particle effects.
[*] Tweaked pause menu for improved usability.
[*] Increased visibility in "Offices?", "Containers?", and both "Vent Shaft" areas.
[*] Minor lore adjustments. 
[*] Doors now close less obviously behind the player 
[*] Added post-processing effects to RevelOS computers.
[*] Minor updates in "The Megastructure."
[*] UI is now enabled by default; subtitles are now disabled by default.
[*] Lighting changes in almost all areas
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed general stability issues and various otherbugs.
[*] Resolved issue preventing full game time from being recorded correctly.
[*] Correct collision sounds now consistently play.
[*] Fixed various collision-related issues.
[*] Fixed bug causing game to break when continuing without an existing save.
[*] Players can now properly interact with picked-up objects.
[*] Resolved camera glitching when interacting with objects.
[*] Fixed RevelOS computer failing to launch.
[*] Fixed issue where RevelOS computers would not play audio correctly.
[/list]


- Stefaaan !!

notes.title: Mik 0.1.5 - Leaderboards!
notes.content:
Hi hello and its finally time for a new update with one of the most requested features - Leaderboards! Along with lots of other bugfixes and changes there is finally some new content and replayability!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added Steam leaderboard with in-game leaderboard display, basic anti-cheat, and basic moderation systems.
[list]
[*] Your times on the leaderboard are counted from the start of the level (meaning that you cant just load any checkpoint and set a record from there). You can find the ingame leaderboard display when you click on your name in the main menu, or in the playtest community hub under "Stats".
[/list]
[*]New secrets added in "The Megastructure."
[*]New RevelOS lore-related application: "Long Range Comms Array."
[*]Steam Cloud Sync: settings and progress now synchronized via Steam Cloud.
[/list]

[h1]Changes & Polish[/h1]

[list]
[*]Restart shortcut now takes less time.
[*]Glass shards now disappear for optimization and visual clarity.
[*]New glass bottle shader implemented.
[*]Minor optimizations through dynamic batching and additional adjustments.
[*]Option and progress files now stored in the correct persistent data path.
[*]Slightly increased music volume levels.
[*]Picked-up objects now rotate smoothly with the player.
[*]Picked-up objects no longer jitter.
[*]Implemented a role system (current role: Developer).
[*]The elevator in "Descent?" is now correctly positioned at the bottom when loading from checkpoints.
[*]Collision particle effects now scale based on collision speed.
[*]Removed music from "Descent?".
[*]Music relocated within "Vent Shaft 13."
[*]Added new computer humming sound.
[*]Computers now visually glitch briefly upon strong impact.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Various collision and clipping issues fixed.
[*]Several main menu issues resolved.
[*]Fixed flare not appearing in "Offices?".
[*]Reverb levels now reset correctly in the main menu.
[*]Fixed camera bobbing functionality.
[*]Application should quit properly on all devices now.
[*]Achievement "1_1" now correctly centered.
[*]Fixed occlusion glitches in "Vent Shaft 13."
[*]Lore text in "Containers?" displays correctly.
[*]Note text in "The Megastructure." displays correctly.
[*]Various additional minor bug fixes.

[*][b]Platform-Specific Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Resolved Linux rendering issues by switching from OpenGL to Vulkan.
[/list]
[/list]


Thanks for playing & giving feedback 
- Stefaaan !!

notes.title: Mik 0.1.4
notes.content:
Another update with general polish and improvements!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]  
[*] Full Level Selector - You can now spawn at specific checkpoints.  
[*] Added option to enable FSR 3.1.  
[*] Added option to toggle UI.  
[*] Added shortcut for restarting the game - Hold [T] to restart.  
[*] Rotate picked-up objects - Hold [R] and use the mouse to rotate objects.  
[*] Glass bottles can now be broken.  
[*] New lore.  
[*] Various polish and game design improvements across multiple areas.  
[/list]  

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]  
[*] Fixed various missing collisions.  
[*] Fixed multiple small bugs.  
[*] Player should no longer get stuck in vents or on edges when crouching.  
[*] Fixed subtitles turning on/off when loading the main menu.  
[*] Secret in the ventilation area now loads properly when respawning.  
[*] Fixed a bug where you could exit the "Playtest Complete" screen and continue playing.  
[*] Fixed a note in "Factory?" not displaying the correct text.  
[*] Optimized "The Megastructure".  
[*] Performance improvements in the ventilation level.  
[*] revelOS stability improvements.  
[/list]


Thanks again to everyone who provided feedback and reported bugs on Discord! Now that the game is more stable and polished, I can start working on actual content again!

notes.title: Mik 0.1.3
notes.content:
Hi Hello - the first Playtest update is finally here, fixing some critical bugs and adding some quality-of-life features!

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[h3]Added a command line[/h3]
[list]
[*] Open with '^' (like in Source games)
[*] Press Escape and select the input box with your mouse
[*] Type help for a list of commands
[/list]
[h3]Added a mouse sensitivity setting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Located in the Advanced Settings menu
[/list]

[h3]Added Linux & MacOS builds[/h3]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would launch Discord if it was not running
[*] Fixed a bug where the game wouldn’t launch properly without Discord
[*] Picked-up objects now scale properly when crouching/uncrouching
[*] Throwing picked-up objects gives them more velocity
[*] Uncrouch spamming to clip through floors shouldn't work anymore
[*] Minor movement improvements
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who reported bugs and provided feedback!
